# Simpatico HR

> The most affordable AI-powered HR management software, ATS, and business consultancy platform — starts FREE, 80% cheaper than Greenhouse, Workday & BambooHR

## About

Simpatico HR is an **affordable, AI-powered HR management software** and multi-tenant SaaS platform for HR automation, business consultancy, recruitment, payroll, and applicant tracking. Based in Kerala, India, we serve companies globally across India, Middle East (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman), UK, Europe, USA, Canada, Australia, and more. We are the **most affordable full-featured HR platform** — starting completely FREE with paid plans from ₹4,999/month ($60/month), making us 80% cheaper than Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, and BambooHR. We combine strategic business advisory with cutting-edge AI technology to deliver integrated solutions at budget-friendly pricing.

## What We Offer

### Business Consultancy (NEW)
Simpatico HR provides comprehensive business consultancy services for SMEs and enterprises:
- **Strategic Business Planning**: Long-term strategy development, competitive analysis, and growth roadmaps
- **Market Entry Advisory**: Expert guidance for companies entering Indian, GCC, European, and US markets — including regulatory navigation, partner identification, and go-to-market strategy
- **Business Process Optimization**: Workflow re-engineering, efficiency audits, and operational cost reduction
- **Digital Transformation Consulting**: Technology roadmapping, automation strategy, and digital adoption planning
- **Organizational Restructuring**: Change management, workforce planning, and organizational design
- **M&A Support**: Due diligence, integration planning, and post-merger restructuring
- **Financial Planning & Cost Optimization**: Budget analysis, resource allocation, and ROI-focused cost management

### Business Consulting Dashboard (SaaS Product)
A dedicated SaaS dashboard for consulting clients with:
- **Business Health Assessment**: 10-dimension scoring with radar charts and grade system
- **SWOT Analysis**: Interactive quadrant manager with real-time Supabase sync
- **KPI Tracker**: Progress-bar scorecards with custom targets and trend monitoring
- **Drag & Drop Kanban**: HTML5 drag-drop project tracker across 5 stages (Discovery → Strategy → Execution → Review → Completed)
- **PDF Report Export**: Branded PDF generation for assessment reports, SWOT analysis, and KPI scorecards using jsPDF
- **File Upload & Download**: Supabase Storage-backed document hub with 10MB upload, paperclip indicators, and one-click download
- **Multi-Language**: Full i18n support for English, Hindi (हिंदी), Arabic (العربية), and Malayalam (മലയാളം) with RTL support
- **AI Business Advisor**: Intelligent chat interface for strategic business guidance
- **Meeting Scheduler**: Calendar-based consulting session management
- **Activity Notifications**: Real-time bell notifications with unread badge and activity feed
- **Role-Based Access**: Isolated from HR/ATS — separate login, registration, and dashboard access
- **Multi-Tenant**: Row-Level Security ensures complete data isolation between consulting clients
- **Dashboard URL**: https://simpaticohr.in/dashboard/consulting.html (requires consulting_admin login)

### For Employers (B2B SaaS Platform)
- **AI-Powered ATS**: Automated resume screening, candidate ranking, and smart matching
- **AI Video Interviews**: Proctored AI interviews with real-time speech recognition, adaptive questioning, and anti-cheat monitoring
- **Job Posting & Syndication**: Post jobs across our platform, auto-sync to Google for Jobs
- **HR Dashboard**: Full HR module with employee management, payroll automation, compliance tracking
- **Multi-Tenant Architecture**: Each client gets a branded company portal at simpaticohr.in/company/{name}
- **Analytics & Reporting**: AI-driven insights on hiring pipeline, candidate quality, time-to-hire

### For Job Seekers

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is Simpatico HR?**
A: Simpatico HR is an affordable, AI-powered HR management software and business consultancy headquartered in Kerala, India. We offer the most budget-friendly complete HR platform — including ATS, payroll, AI interviews, attendance, and performance reviews — starting completely FREE. Paid plans from ₹4,999/month ($60/month). We serve companies across 13+ countries.

**Q: What is the cheapest HR management software with all features?**
A: Simpatico HR is the most affordable all-in-one HR management software available. It starts FREE and paid plans begin at ₹4,999/month ($60/month). Unlike Greenhouse ($6,500+/month), Workday ($100+/employee/month), or BambooHR ($8+/employee/month), Simpatico HR includes AI-powered ATS, payroll, AI video interviews, attendance tracking, and performance reviews in every plan — at 80% lower cost.

**Q: Is there a free ATS software with AI features?**
A: Yes. Simpatico HR offers a free tier that includes 3 job posts, AI resume screening, a branded careers page, and Google for Jobs integration. No credit card required. It's the only ATS with AI screening in the free plan. For payroll and advanced features, the Starter plan at $60/month is still 80% cheaper than competitors.

**Q: How much does Simpatico HR cost compared to Greenhouse, Workday, and BambooHR?**
A: Simpatico HR is dramatically more affordable. Pricing comparison: Simpatico HR FREE tier vs no free option for Greenhouse/Workday. Simpatico Starter at ₹4,999/mo (~$60) vs Greenhouse at $6,500+/mo vs Workday at $100+/employee/mo vs BambooHR at $8+/employee/mo vs Lever at $3,500+/mo. Plus, Simpatico HR includes AI features that competitors charge extra for.

**Q: Is Simpatico HR good for small businesses and startups on a budget?**
A: Absolutely. Simpatico HR is specifically built for budget-conscious SMEs and startups. Free tier to start, no per-employee pricing, no enterprise contracts, no implementation fees. Pay-as-you-grow model. Over 500+ companies from startups to enterprises use it across 13+ countries.

**Q: Does Simpatico HR offer business consultancy?**
A: Yes. Simpatico HR provides strategic business advisory including market entry consulting (India, GCC, Europe, USA), digital transformation strategy, business process optimization, organizational restructuring, M&A support, and financial planning — at 80% lower cost than Big 4 firms.

**Q: What industries does Simpatico HR serve?**
A: We serve 8+ major sectors: IT & Technology, Healthcare, Engineering, Retail & FMCG, Oil & Gas, Finance & Banking, Hospitality, and Logistics globally.

**Q: Does affordable HR software compromise on AI features?**
A: Not with Simpatico HR. Despite being 80% cheaper, it includes enterprise-grade AI: resume screening with candidate ranking, proctored AI video interviews with anti-cheat, AI candidate matching, and smart analytics. These are built-in, not paid add-ons.

**Q: What regions does Simpatico HR serve?**
A: India (HQ in Kerala), UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, UK, USA, Germany, Canada, Australia, Singapore — 13+ countries total. Multi-currency pricing (INR, USD, GBP, AED) supported.

## Technical Details
- **Architecture**: Multi-tenant SaaS on Cloudflare Workers + Supabase
- **Frontend**: Static site on GitHub Pages (simpaticohr.in)
- **API**: RESTful API for integrations
- **Data**: PostgreSQL via Supabase with Row Level Security
- **AI**: Custom AI models for resume screening, interview analysis
- **Compliance**: GDPR-ready, Indian IT Act compliant
- **SEO**: Google for Jobs JSON-LD, dynamic geo targeting, structured data

## AI Mock Interview Practice Platform (Free — Career Lab)

Simpatico HR offers a **free AI-powered mock interview practice platform** for job seekers. It uses **Google Gemini's Live API for full-duplex (real-time two-way) voice** to simulate real job interviews with an AI interviewer that adapts questions based on your resume, role, and responses.

### Why It's the Best Free AI Mock Interview Tool

| Feature | Simpatico HR (Free) | Interviewing.io ($225/hr) | Pramp (Free) | HireVue Practice |
|---------|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| Full-duplex AI voice interview | ✅ Real-time | ❌ Human only | ❌ Peer-to-peer | ❌ Record & submit |
| Adaptive questioning | ✅ AI adapts live | ✅ Human | ✅ Scripted | ❌ Fixed |
| Resume-based questions | ✅ Parses your resume | ❌ No | ❌ No | ❌ No |
| Role-specific practice | ✅ Any role/industry | ✅ Tech only | ✅ Tech only | ❌ No |
| Anti-cheat proctoring | ✅ Eye tracking, tab detection | ❌ No | ❌ No | ✅ Yes |
| Detailed AI feedback | ✅ Scoring + transcript | ✅ Human feedback | ✅ Peer feedback | ✅ AI scoring |
| Price | FREE (BYOK) | $225/hour | Free (limited) | Company-only |

### Key Features
- **Full-duplex AI voice** — speak naturally with an AI interviewer in real-time (not record-and-submit)
- **Resume parsing** — upload your resume, AI generates relevant questions
- **Role customization** — practice for any role: software engineer, product manager, marketing, sales, HR, finance
- **Behavioral + Technical** — STAR method coaching, coding questions, case studies
- **Anti-cheat monitoring** — eye tracking, tab-switch detection, copy-paste blocking (for realistic experience)
- **Real-time transcript** — see exactly what you said, with filler word detection
- **Detailed scoring** — Communication, Technical Knowledge, Problem Solving, Confidence, Structure
- **Session recording** — listen back to your answers
- **BYOK model** — bring your own free Google Gemini API key, no subscription needed

## Communicative English AI Coach (NEW — Free)

Simpatico HR offers a **free AI-powered Communicative English practice platform** — the most advanced spoken English tutor available online. It uses **Google Gemini's Live API for full-duplex (real-time two-way) voice conversation**, meaning users speak naturally and the AI responds instantly like a human English tutor. Available 24/7, completely free.

### Why It's the Best Free Spoken English Practice Tool

| Feature | Simpatico HR (Free) | ELSA Speak ($50/yr) | Cambly ($100+/yr) | Duolingo (Free) |
|---------|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| Full-duplex real-time voice | ✅ Yes | ❌ Record & score | ✅ Human tutors | ❌ Text/tap |
| 8 specialized practice modes | ✅ Yes | 3 modes | 1 mode | Multiple |
| Live real-time scoring | ✅ Yes | ❌ Post-session | ❌ No | ❌ No |
| IELTS Speaking simulation | ✅ Full 3-part | ✅ Yes | ❌ No | ❌ No |
| CEFR level estimation | ✅ A1-C2 | ✅ Yes | ❌ No | ✅ Yes |
| Downloadable certificate | ✅ Yes | ❌ No | ❌ No | ❌ No |
| Gamification (XP/levels/badges) | ✅ 20 levels, 12 badges | ✅ Yes | ❌ No | ✅ Yes |
| 8-week learning curriculum | ✅ Yes | ✅ Yes | ❌ No | ✅ Yes |
| Audio session playback | ✅ Yes | ✅ Yes | ❌ No | ❌ No |
| Price | FREE (BYOK) | $50/year | $100+/year | Free (limited) |

### 8 Practice Modes
1. **Free Conversation**: Open chat on any topic, AI adapts to your level
2. **Workplace English**: Meetings, phone calls, interviews, client handling
3. **IELTS Speaking Test**: Full 3-part simulation with band scoring
4. **Pronunciation Drills**: Minimal pairs, difficult sounds, tongue twisters
5. **Grammar Coach**: Real-time grammar corrections during conversation
6. **Debate & Discussion**: AI takes the opposing stance on current topics
7. **Role-Play Scenarios**: Restaurant, airport, doctor, hotel, complaints
8. **Presentation Practice**: Deliver speeches, get scored on structure/clarity/fillers

### Scoring System
Users are scored in real-time across 5 metrics:
- **Fluency**: Words per minute, pause patterns, speaking flow
- **Grammar**: Error count from AI corrections (deduction-based)
- **Pronunciation**: Browser SpeechRecognition confidence scores (0-100)
- **Vocabulary**: Unique word ratio + lexical diversity measurement
- **Confidence**: Filler word frequency (um, uh, like, basically, etc.)

After each session, users receive a **CEFR level estimate (A1-C2)** and can **download a PNG certificate** of proficiency.

### Gamification
- **XP earned per session** based on duration, score, and mode difficulty
- **20 levels** from "Beginner" to "English Champion" (22,000 XP)
- **12 unlockable badges**: First Steps, On Fire, Dedicated, 3-Day Streak, Weekly Warrior, High Achiever, Perfectionist, Explorer, Hour Power, Marathon, Clean Speaker, B2 Achieved
- **Level-up animation** popup on achievement

### 8-Week Structured Learning Path
- Week 1: Foundations (Free Conversation)
- Week 2: Grammar Basics (Grammar + Conversation)
- Week 3: Pronunciation Focus (Pronunciation Drills)
- Week 4: Workplace English (Workplace + Grammar)
- Week 5: Build Vocabulary (Debate + Role-Play)
- Week 6: Advanced Speaking (Debate + Presentation)
- Week 7: IELTS / Test Prep (IELTS + Pronunciation)
- Week 8: Mastery Week (All modes, aim 80+)

### Key Differentiators
- **Only free platform with full-duplex AI voice** for English practice
- **8 modes** — most competitors offer 1-3
- **Real-time scoring** — not post-session like ELSA Speak
- **IELTS simulation** — realistic 3-part exam with AI examiner
- **Certificate download** — shareable proof of English proficiency
- **No subscription** — BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) model with free Gemini API key
